name: Sausage, Peppers & Potato Bake
desc: Browned Italian sausage, potatoes, bell peppers, and onions baked together in white wine and chicken stock.

source.title: Sausage, Peppers, Onions, and Potato Bake
source.evidence: Every ingredient and amount matches this page (2 lb Italian sausage, 4 large potatoes, 2 green and 2 red peppers, 3 large onions, 1/2 cup each wine and stock, 1 tsp Italian seasoning), as do the brown-then-bake method and 400°F oven.

ingredients.raw: 2 tsp olive oil, for the sausage
2 lb sweet or hot Italian sausage links, cut into 2-inch pieces
1/4 cup olive oil, for the potatoes
4 large russet potatoes, peeled and cut into 1/2-inch slices
2 large green bell peppers, seeded and cut into wedges
2 large red bell peppers, seeded and cut into wedges
3 large yellow onions, cut into wedges
Kosher salt and black pepper, to taste

steps: Heat the 2 tsp olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat. Cook the sausage, turning, until browned on all sides, 6-8 min. Move it to a large baking dish or roasting pan (a 9x13 in dish will be very full; a larger pan is better).
Pour the 1/4 cup olive oil into the same skillet and cook the potato slices, stirring now and then, until browned, about 10 min. Add them to the baking dish, leaving some oil behind.
Cook the green and red peppers and onions in the skillet, stirring, until they begin to soften, about 5 min. Add them to the dish.
Pour the wine and stock over everything, sprinkle with the Italian seasoning, salt, and pepper, and stir gently to mix.
Bake until bubbling, the potatoes are tender when pierced, and the sausage reads 160°F inside, 20-25 min. Serve hot.
tips: Work in batches if the skillet is crowded; potatoes piled up steam instead of browning.
